_comment: Template for scripts/seed-rates.mjs. Copy to rates.json and replace EVERY number
with your real rates — these are placeholders chosen to be obviously wrong, not
suggestions. Anything here becomes a client's quoted price.
Column names are the real ones: meal_rates uses meal_type + base_rate_eur (one row
per meal per tier), vehicles uses daily_rate + passenger_capacity, guides uses
daily_rate + languages. The generator filters by tier, so a tier with no rows simply
stays unpriced rather than being guessed.
Omit a section entirely to leave that table untouched.
Add "tenant_id": "<uuid>" at the top level to load one tenant only; by default
the same rates are written to every tenant.
